title: docume.json
description: Configuration for a repo whose markdown wiki is published to Confluence Cloud by the DocuMe CLI (PLAN.md §5.1). Committed to the repo, and therefore secret-free: credentials come from DOCUME_CONFLUENCE_EMAIL and DOCUME_CONFLUENCE_TOKEN only.

$schema.description: This schema's URL. Written by `docume init`; ignored by the loader.

agent.description: Which coding agent the repo's model-running workflows (docs-refresh, docs-feedback) are written for. Recorded by `docume init --agent`; absent means claude, the rail every repo scaffolded before the copilot rail existed is on.

baseUrl.description: Confluence wiki base URL, e.g. https://example.atlassian.net/wiki. Required.

spaceKey.description: Space key to publish into, e.g. DOCS. Required.

spaceId.description: Numeric space id. Resolved from spaceKey when absent.

rootPageId.description: Page the wiki tree is published under. The space root when absent.

protectedSpaces.description: Space keys this repo is not cleared to publish into. A run targeting one refuses to write unless a human passes --allow-protected-space for that single run.

root.description: Root of the markdown wiki within the repo. Required.

exclude.description: Globs, relative to wiki.root, that are not published.

extraPages.description: Excluded files republished anyway, each under a chosen title.

title.description: Confluence page title. Must be unique across the space.

homePage.description: Index filename. Applies per directory, not only at the root: a directory's index page is the parent of its pages in Confluence.

maxChildren.description: How many children one parent may have before `docume status`'s structure check warns. A warning only: nothing fails a build over it.

approved.description: Label a reviewer adds to accept a page. Removed automatically when the page's content changes.

stale.description: Label added by `docume drift --mark` to a page whose sources changed.

title.description: Title of the generated status page.

defaultBranch.description: Branch a pull-request drift check diffs against.

repoBlobUrl.description: Optional base URL for linkifying source references at the baseline commit.

renderer.description: Path to the render-mermaid.mjs wrapper that turns a mermaid fence into an SVG attachment.
